note: First verdict 2026-09-29. Positive rfc7854_message_layout_test.go::TestRFC7854InitiationIsTheCommonHeaderThenTwoOrMoreTLVs reads the octets sender.go::sendInitiation writes off a pipe, checks type 4 and walks TLVs by hand from octet 6 to exactly the end, requiring >= 2. Negative (R1(a)) ::TestRFC7854InitiationWithFewerThanTwoTLVsIsRefused: a one-TLV Initiation is refused by the receiver. The refusal comes from decodeInitiation's sysName-presence check (RFC7854-x-18), not a count check, but every one-TLV Initiation lacks sysName or sysDescr, so no one-TLV input is accepted; the buffer is otherwise valid.
